Google Maps Scraper Kit

Last verified working: 2026-10-14 with engine v1.18.1 on macOS Apple Silicon.

A free, open-source Google Maps scraper for lead generation that runs on your own machine. Name a business type and a city. Get back an outreach-ready CSV with name, phone, email, website, category, address, rating and review count. Add --socials for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.

No Google Maps API key, no SaaS credits, no data leaving your computer. One Docker command starts the engine. Then run it from the terminal, or let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor drive it for you in plain English.

Quick start

Requires Docker Desktop. Python 3 is optional and uses the standard library only.

git clone https://github.com/Mahanaicoach/google-maps-scraper-kit.git
cd google-maps-scraper-kit
docker compose up -d
./scripts/scrape.sh "coffee shops in Austin TX" 30.2672 -97.7431 5

No coordinates handy? Let the Python CLI geocode the city:

python3 scripts/scrape.py "dentists in Denver CO" --city "Denver, CO" --depth 5 --socials

Need the whole city, not just the first 120? Add --grid 3:

python3 scripts/scrape.py "dentists in Denver CO" --city "Denver, CO" --grid 3

Example output

coffee_shops_austin.csv (illustrative rows):

title phone emails website category address review_rating review_count
Example Roasters +1 512-555-0101 hello@example.com example.com Coffee shop 100 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 4.7 812
Sample Espresso Bar +1 512-555-0102 info@example.org example.org Cafe 200 S Lamar Blvd, Austin, TX 4.5 356

--socials adds instagram, facebook and linkedin columns. --full keeps all ~34 raw fields, including opening hours, coordinates, price range and reviews.

Full walkthrough, platform notes and troubleshooting: SETUP.md.

Use it with Claude Code or any agent

The kit ships a Claude Code skill that teaches the agent the exact job API, the required fields, polling, CSV cleanup and the rate-limit guardrails. It also works with Codex, Cursor and any other Agent Skills-compatible tool.

Option A: open the folder in Claude Code. The skill and four slash commands load automatically.

cd google-maps-scraper-kit
claude

Option B: install the skill into an agent you already use.

npx skills add mahanaicoach/google-maps-scraper-kit

Then ask in plain language:

Scrape gyms in Miami and give me phones, emails and websites.

The agent checks the engine is up and starts it if not, builds the job, polls in the background, downloads the CSV, keeps the 8 lead fields, and hands you a clean table plus the file.

Slash command (Claude Code) Action
/scrape <business> in <city, ST> [depth] Run one scrape, return a clean table and CSV
/scrape-batch <keywords-file> [--city "City, ST"] Run many queries as one job
/scrape-setup Start the engine and run a health check
/scrape-jobs [list | delete <id>] List or delete jobs

Plain requests trigger the skill too: "build me a lead list of plumbers in Phoenix". The skill scrapes Google Maps business listings only. It does not scrape social platforms directly.

What you get
8 lead fields by default name, phone, email, website, category, address, rating, review count. The engine captures ~34 raw fields; --full keeps them all.
Email extraction, on by default Visits each business website and pulls published contact emails. A second pass checks the contact and about pages of rows still missing one, then prints your found rate.
Beyond the 120 cap --grid 3 splits the city into 3 x 3 map tiles, runs them one at a time and dedupes on place_id.
Social enrichment --socials finds Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn profiles in code (HTTP + regex). Zero AI tokens.
Auto-geocoding Type a city name. Coordinates are resolved for you via OpenStreetMap.
Batch jobs Many keywords, one job, one CSV.
Proxy rotation Built into the engine for large or repeated runs. socks5, socks5h, http, https.
Agent-native A skill plus four slash commands. The agent handles create, poll, download, clean and present.
Safe defaults API bound to 127.0.0.1, results git-ignored, rate-limit and data-law guardrails built into the skill.

Batch jobs and the Python CLI

scripts/scrape.py is a standalone, dependency-free Python CLI: single queries, batches, geocoding, socials and CSV output. It works on macOS, Linux and Windows.

python3 scripts/scrape.py --keywords-file examples/queries.example.txt --city "Denver, CO"

One keyword per line. One job. One CSV.

Honest limits

  • About 120 listings per search. Google Maps stops scrolling at roughly 120 results per search. That is Google's cap, not the kit's. --grid is the fix: it splits the city into N x N map tiles, runs one search per tile in a single batch, and dedupes the results on place_id. Tiles run one at a time, so a grid is slower and more likely to trip rate limits than a single search.
  • Emails only when a business publishes one. The extractor reads the business website, then a second pass checks its contact and about pages. Listings with no site, or a site with no visible email, return an empty emails cell. Instagram bios are not read. Expect emails on a fraction of rows, not all of them.
  • Rate limits are real. Heavy use without proxies can get your IP temporarily rate-limited by Google for minutes to hours. Your Google account is not affected. See Responsible use.
  • Apple Silicon runs the engine under amd64 emulation. It works. It is slower than native. SETUP.md has the native fallback.

Ask a chat AI to "scrape Google Maps" and it hits a consent wall and JavaScript-rendered pages, so you get close to zero structured rows. This kit runs a real headless scraping engine locally and gives the agent a precise operating manual for it.

FAQ

Is this Google Maps scraper free? Yes. The kit is MIT licensed and the engine it runs is open source. There are no credits, subscriptions or API keys. You only need Docker on your own machine.

Do I need a Google Maps API key or the Google Places API? No. The kit drives a headless browser against Google Maps directly, so there is no API quota or billing.

How is this different from gosom/google-maps-scraper? gosom/google-maps-scraper is the scraping engine, and this kit runs its official Docker image. The kit adds the lead-focused layer on top: a one-command local setup, a dependency-free Python CLI with geocoding and batching, email and social enrichment to a clean 8-column CSV, and a Claude Code skill with slash commands and safety guardrails. See CREDITS.md.

Do I need Claude Code to use it? No. Claude Code makes it hands-free through a skill and slash commands, but scripts/scrape.py and scripts/scrape.sh run on their own from any terminal.

Does it work with Codex, Cursor or other agents? Yes. npx skills add mahanaicoach/google-maps-scraper-kit installs the skill into any Agent Skills-compatible tool. The /scrape slash commands are Claude Code only.

What data do I get for each business? Name, phone, email, website, category, address, rating and review count by default. Add --socials for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, or --full for all ~34 raw fields.

How many leads can I scrape? Up to about 120 per search. Add --grid 3 to split the city into 9 map tiles and get past that cap, with duplicates removed. Batch as many keywords as you like in one job. For large or repeated runs, add proxies (see Responsible use).

Does it work on Windows, Linux and Apple Silicon Macs? Yes. Anywhere Docker runs. On Windows, use scripts/scrape.py, or run scrape.sh under WSL2 or Git Bash. SETUP.md covers the Apple Silicon note.

Is scraping Google Maps legal? It is against Google's Terms of Service, and phones and emails are personal data. Read Responsible use and follow GDPR, CCPA and CAN-SPAM. This is not legal advice.

Responsible use

This drives a real scraper against Google Maps. Light use is fine. Heavy use without proxies can get your IP temporarily rate-limited (minutes to hours). Your Google account is not affected.

  • Run one job at a time. Start at depth 5 and raise only when needed.
  • Watch for block signals: failed jobs, empty results, or far fewer rows than an identical earlier run.
  • Add proxies for large or repeated runs. The engine rotates them automatically:
    "proxies": ["socks5://user:pass@host:port", "http://host2:port2"]
  • Treat output as leads to verify, not a dataset to resell. Phones and emails are personal data: follow GDPR, CCPA and CAN-SPAM.

For large requests, the agent flags the risk and suggests proxies, then proceeds. It refuses only clearly abusive use.

Support

Found a bug? Open an issue with the command you ran and the error. Issues are for problems with the kit. Run your own scrapes with the quick start above; requests like "find me hotels in Hamburg" are closed without action. Contributions: CONTRIBUTING.md. Security reports: SECURITY.md.
